name: Config error: an invalid storage_mode outranks a co-occurring operator error
description: When a config violates storage_mode AND something else at once, which error is reported first is externally observable, so the three runtimes must agree. pine-go and pine-java check the storage_mode whitelist first in validate(); pine-cpp originally checked it in validate_config, which runs at the END of load_config_from_json, after operator parsing — so it reported 'operator "...": missing type_name' where the other two reported the storage_mode error (measured during issue #187's audit). Fixed by validating the value at parse time in pine-cpp. This repo treats first-error priority under simultaneous violations as an external contract; see memory/reflections/review-driven-build-input-error-ordering.md. 注意 `wrapping_exact` 是**包含**匹配（`05-error-parity.sh` 用 `grep -qF`），不是相等匹配：它钉住的是消息**前缀**，某一方在末尾**追加**内容不会让它变红——实测给 pine-go 的文案加 " (see docs)" 后 section 05 仍 35/35 全绿。所以这条 fixture 钉的是「前缀一致」，不是完整的字节对等；中段改词会红（已验证），尾部追加不会。

expected_error.wrapping_exact: pine: config error: storage_mode "colunm" is invalid, must be "row" or "column"
